name: Abbas Mahmoud al-Aqqad
contribution: An Egyptian journalist, poet and literary critic, and member of the Academy of the Arabic Language in Cairo.

checks.lead: Abbas Mahmoud al-Aqqad (Arabic: عباس محمود العقاد, ALA-LC: ‘Abbās Maḥmūd al-‘Aqqād; 28 June 1889 – 12 March 1964) was an Egyptian journalist, poet and literary critic, and member of the Academy of the Arabic Language in Cairo.
